description: This file contains utility functions for image processing tasks, including reading files, decoding images, creating image grids, drawing bounding boxes and labels, and converting tensors to numpy arrays. It serves as a support module for image datasets or model visualization within an object detection or image analysis project.

methods.name: torch.Tensor read_file(path: str)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file as a byte tensor.

methods.name: torch.Tensor decode_image(input: torch.Tensor, mode: ImageReadMode = ImageReadMode.UNCHANGED)
methods.description: Decodes raw byte tensor into an image tensor (RGB or grayscale).

methods.name: torch.Tensor read_image(path: str, mode: ImageReadMode = ImageReadMode.UNCHANGED)
methods.description: Reads an image file (JPEG/PNG) into an RGB or grayscale tensor with optional mode.

methods.name: _generate_color_palette(num_objects: int)
methods.description: Generates a color palette of distinct colors for object labels.

methods.name: torch.Tensor make_grid( tensor: Union[torch.Tensor, List[torch.Tensor]], nrow: int = 8, padding: int = 2, normalize: bool = False, value_range: Optional[Tuple[int, int]] = None, scale_each: bool = False, pad_value: float = 0.0, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Creates a grid of images from a batch or list of image tensors.

methods.name: torch.Tensor draw_bounding_boxes_and_labels( image: torch.Tensor, boxes: torch.Tensor, draw_boxes: bool, labels: Optional[List[str]] = None, label_color: Optional[Union[List[Union[str, Tuple[int, int, int]]], str, Tuple[int, int, int]]] = None, box_color: Optional[Union[List[Union[str, Tuple[int, int, int]]], str, Tuple[int, int, int]]] = None, fill: Optional[bool] = False, width: int = 1, font: Optional[str] = None, font_size: int = 10, )
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and labels on an image tensor.

methods.name: None tensor_to_ndarray( tensor: Union[torch.Tensor, List[torch.Tensor]], **kwargs, )
methods.description: Converts a tensor (or batch) to a numpy ndarray image.
